oracle.description: templates/dispatch/tests/test_release_scorecard_build.py decides correctness: the scorecard's two sources joined into one release row without either standing in for the other. The empty-receipts fixture is the load-bearing one -- a scorecard that quietly reports the frontier figure as the whole cost is the exact miscount T-6 exists to prevent.

purpose: Add one function, build_scorecard(release, rows, receipts, escalations, recorded_at), to templates/dispatch/scripts/release_scorecard.py, and change nothing already in it. It is a pure function over already-parsed inputs: no file reading, no writing, no argument parsing, no git. It returns exactly the top-level keys schema_version, release, recorded_at, frontier, worker, escalations and cost_usd. schema_version is the literal string workflow-scorecard/v1; release and recorded_at are carried through verbatim. frontier is frontier_totals(rows) and worker is worker_totals(receipts) -- delegate to them, do not re-implement either, and in particular the frontier half must be computed from the reduced rows, since a scorecard built on the quadratic sum is the exact miscount this whole row exists to prevent. escalations is built from parsed auditctl workflow.escalation records, whose task_id and optional stop_condition live under a metadata key, and is {count, tasks, stop_conditions}: the number of records, the sorted distinct task ids, and the sorted distinct stop conditions with records carrying none omitted rather than contributing a null. Two escalations on one task count as two but name that task once, and an empty list yields a zero count with empty lists rather than missing keys. cost_usd is {frontier, worker, total, total_reliable}: the two halves, their sum rounded to six places, and worker's cost_reported -- the total is only as trustworthy as its least certain half, and a provider that reports no cost is indistinguishable from a free one. The two sources are the point of the row and neither substitutes for the other: the hooks never see an OpenCode worker so the hook sink alone undercounts a loop run, and the receipts know nothing about frontier turns. With no receipts at all the worker half is still present with zeroes and both halves stay separately visible; it must never collapse to the frontier figure. Do not mutate any input. Leave no debugging output behind.
required_outcomes: the frontier half delegates to frontier_totals over reduced rows
the worker half delegates to worker_totals
both halves stay separately visible even when one is empty
escalations count records but name tasks once, and omit absent stop conditions
cost_usd.total is the sum and total_reliable is the worker's cost_reported
no input is mutated and nothing else in the module changes

acceptance_properties.requirement: the release row is built from both sources, not one
acceptance_properties.fails_when: the worker half is absent or collapses into the frontier figure when no receipts are given

acceptance_properties.requirement: the frontier half never carries the quadratic sum
acceptance_properties.fails_when: a multi-stop session reaches the scorecard summed rather than reduced

acceptance_properties.requirement: a combined total says how far it can be trusted
acceptance_properties.fails_when: total_reliable stays true while a contributing receipt reported no cost

non_goals: reduce_sessions, frontier_totals, worker_spend_from_receipt and worker_totals, which are settled
the CLI, the tag-range resolution and the scorecard file write
